artifact_kind: independently authored synthetic usability and evidence oracle
status: provisional; awaiting critic, two skeptics and parent policy freeze
provenance: Original fictional source text and user questions authored for this milestone. No private books, outside text, models or new dependencies. Existing service, web and evaluation sources were read to understand interfaces; this is not a blind or statistically representative benchmark.
execution_status: No corpus was generated and no application, import, test, lint, build or benchmark was run while authoring this draft.
independence_rules: Freeze the authored document text, questions, intended scopes and relevant source spans before candidate execution.
Do not derive relevant passages, expected no-match labels or answerability labels from application output.
Do not revise a question or label merely to make an observed retrieval result pass. Report discrepancies against the frozen oracle.
Edition labels below are author annotations, not an assumption that the current catalog stores edition metadata. Both PDFs intentionally have exactly the same title.
Resolve document labels to actual SHA-256 book identities after generating the synthetic files on Spark. Retain the generated file hashes and fixture manifest.
Use no background corpus. All authored nonblank pages and EPUB sections are short enough for one ordinary source chunk each.
Keep the existing frozen quality and lexical-heldout case files unchanged. Their outcomes remain separate from these new disclosed cases.

shared_expectations.positive_result_membership: Each listed relevant document/location must appear; no passage outside that exact relevant document/location set is expected. Require each authored quote as an unchanged contained source span.
shared_expectations.ranking: No relevance ordering is authored. Preserve actual service order and citation numbering when comparing HTTP, CLI and MCP behavior.
shared_expectations.citations: Every quote must resolve to the independently authored document and physical page or EPUB member, with correct source hash, chunk identity and Unicode character offsets. Check extracted fixture text against authored text before queries; do not silently rewrite labels if fixture extraction differs.
shared_expectations.no_match: Expected no-match means no matching evidence in the requested indexed-book scope. It must not trigger an automatic wider search or a claim about all knowledge outside that scope.
shared_expectations.coverage: Keep recorded PDF omissions, unknown EPUB omission information and unassessed extraction completeness distinct. Show scoped coverage even when no passages match.
shared_expectations.identity: Same-title books require distinct stable selection values derived from their full book identities. A title alone cannot identify an edition. Display labels may use bounded identity hints; never expose a local source path.
shared_expectations.question_preservation: Keep the submitted question, selected book identity and technical-token spelling visible and intact. Selection is explicit user scope, not an inferred edition or automatic newest-edition choice.
shared_expectations.source_limitations: The documents are fictional station manuals. Their measurements and procedures are synthetic examples, not factual advice.

pages.text: Edition 2022. The observation interval is 18 minutes. Record readings in the blue ledger.
The rain gauge uses the copper funnel. Keep the inlet above the splash rim.
Set --trace-log to record a diagnostic trail before a sensor check.
Edition 2026. The observation interval is 42 minutes. Record readings in the green ledger.

pages.author_note: An intentionally blank physical page. Its omission is known; no unseen answer-bearing text is asserted.

pages.text: The rain gauge uses the silver funnel. The rain gauge service life has not been measured.
The option --trace-logger rotates diagnostic files. Ordinary trace log notes are written on paper.
Call station::sample to collect one reading. Call station::sample_all for a full sweep.

sections.text: The bench serial label is SB-73. This label identifies the demonstration enclosure.
Use station::sample_all to collect a full sweep. The words station sample are a bench label.

scenarios.user_intent: Find the observation interval before deciding which edition applies.
scenarios.question: What is the observation interval?

relevant.quote: Edition 2022. The observation interval is 18 minutes.
Edition 2026. The observation interval is 42 minutes.

scenarios.answerability: Conflicting edition-specific values. Retrieval should expose both sources; it does not establish one universally applicable interval.
scenarios.workflow_expectation: The reader can distinguish the same-title source identities and explicitly choose either book. Do not silently prefer the latest-looking edition.
